core: NK and NKT cell expansion and differentiation
name: IL-15 and IL-21-driven NK and NKT cell expansion
rationale: Members are IL-15/IL-21 signaling and NK/NKT cell proliferation, differentiation and activation; the NKT cell regulation terms and the IL-15/IL-21 pairing separate it from confusables built on IL-2/7 or IL-10/12/23/27 signaling.

qualifier: with FLT3-STAT5 signaling and its CBL control
name: RUNX1 transcriptional programs and FLT3-STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members combine RUNX-family target-gene regulation in hematopoietic and other lineages with FLT3 signaling, STAT5 activation and CBL-mediated negative regulation; RUNX1-only confusables lack the FLT3/STAT5/CBL arm and FLT3-fusion or interleukin confusables lack the RUNX arm.

core: fibroblast activity and fibrotic tissue repair
name: TGF-beta/SMAD-regulated fibroblast activity and fibrotic repair
rationale: Members cover fibroblast differentiation and survival, extracellular matrix and collagen control and connective tissue replacement, together with positive and negative regulation of TGF-beta/SMAD signaling (including SMAD-linked miRNA control); the TGF-beta/SMAD regulators are what the fibrosis, cardiac and miRNA-processing confusables lack.

core: striated muscle contraction control by calcium release
name: Ryanodine-receptor calcium release controlling striated muscle contraction
rationale: Members regulate release of sequestered calcium through ryanodine-sensitive channels to control cardiac and skeletal muscle contraction, relaxation and heart rate; confusables instead emphasize positive inotropy/chronotropy and SERCA-mediated calcium reuptake.

core: B cell migration and lymphoid organ development
name: Sphingosine-1-phosphate-guided B cell migration and lymphoid organogenesis
rationale: Members are S1P receptor signaling, migration receptors, B cell chemotaxis, marginal zone B cell differentiation and lymph node development; the S1P receptor component distinguishes it from CXCR4-, T cell- and mucosal lymphoid-focused confusables.

name: Autophagosome formation, maturation and selective cargo capture
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly and maturation and deliver cargo to phagophores (mitophagy, xenophagy, synaptic protein turnover); confusables center on autophagosome/endosome-lysosome fusion or nucleophagy/reticulophagy instead.

name: Cardiomyocyte action potential phases and His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members cover depolarization, plateau and repolarization of atrial and ventricular action potentials plus His-bundle and Purkinje signaling; confusables add potassium-channel resting potential, gap junction coupling or SA node pacemaking instead.

name: Cardiolipin and phosphatidylglycerol synthesis from CDP-diacylglycerol
rationale: All members form the CDP-DAG to phosphatidylglycerol to cardiolipin branch including cardiolipin remodeling, distinct from confusables on phosphatidic acid, triglyceride and phosphatidylcholine synthesis.

name: Thiamine and riboflavin metabolism and membrane transport
rationale: Members are thiamine and riboflavin metabolism, cofactor synthesis and transmembrane transport, separating it from confusables on pantothenate/CoA, carnitine/choline or cobalamin.

name: Trans-Golgi network-endosome trafficking and lysosomal protein delivery
rationale: Members cover TGN vesicle biogenesis, Golgi-endosome exchange in both directions, endosomal fusion and lysosomal protein targeting; confusables focus on COPI, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic.

core: white adipocyte differentiation and adipose tissue development
name: PPAR-regulated white adipogenesis and adipose tissue development
rationale: Members are white fat cell proliferation and differentiation, adipose and fat pad development, adipogenic PPARG programs and PPAR signaling regulation; confusables cover PPARA/circadian mitochondrial biogenesis, thermogenesis or LXR lipid metabolism.

name: Metanephric mesenchyme differentiation into nephron tubule epithelium
rationale: Members cover metanephric mesenchymal maintenance and differentiation, mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition and tubule epithelial formation, whereas confusables cover later nephron segment patterning, ureteric bud/nephric duct or kidney size control.

name: Endosomal neurotransmitter receptor trafficking at the postsynaptic membrane
rationale: Members move receptors (including GluR2 AMPA receptors) between endosomes and the postsynaptic membrane with supporting postsynaptic actin and endosomal vesicle recycling; confusables cover presynaptic active-zone/Rab regulation, receptor clustering or BDNF signaling.

qualifier: endocannabinoid and platelet-activating factor lipid signals
name: Phospholipid and glycerolipid catabolism generating endocannabinoid signals
rationale: Members hydrolyze phospholipids, lysophospholipids, ether lipids, DAG and MAG and metabolize N-acylethanolamines and PAF feeding endocannabinoid signaling; confusables are dominated by glycerophospholipid synthesis and acyl-chain remodeling.

name: Early embryo lineage specification and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members cover inner cell mass, trophectoderm and primordial germ cell specification plus trophoblast differentiation, migration, labyrinth formation and decidualization; confusables concern mammary gland, germline stem cells or gonad development.

name: Psychostimulant response and reward-conditioned behavior
rationale: Members are cocaine, amphetamine and alkaloid responses, DARPP-32 signaling, conditioned place preference and operant conditioning; confusables cover dopamine receptor signaling, neuropeptide/opioid signaling or social and ethanol behaviors.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and Cajal body localization
name: TRiC chaperonin folding and telomerase Cajal body assembly
rationale: Members combine CCT/TRiC and prefoldin folding of actin and tubulin with telomerase holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and telomere extension; confusables have either general/ER folding without telomerase or RNA modification without chaperonin folding.

qualifier: SIRP-mediated restraint of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation
name: Myeloid inflammatory activation with SIRP-mediated phagocytosis restraint
rationale: Members cover inflammatory and TLR responses, monocyte/DC receptor modules and neutrophil degranulation, plus negative regulation of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation via SIRP interactions, which the degranulation, heme/TLR and respiratory-burst confusables lack.

name: Mitochondrial translation and respiratory complex assembly
rationale: Members are mitoribosomal translation initiation/elongation/termination, inner-membrane protein insertion and assembly of complexes I, III, IV and ATP synthase; confusables cover electron transport and ATP synthesis or iron-sulfur cluster assembly instead of translation.

core: cellular cholesterol efflux and HDL assembly
name: Cholesterol efflux, HDL assembly and foam cell formation
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol import, efflux, storage and reverse transport, ABCA1/apoA-I-driven HDL assembly and oxLDL-induced foam cell differentiation; confusables emphasize LDL receptor clearance, SREBP control or lipoprotein remodeling and dietary lipid handling.

qualifier: positive and negative selection and self-tolerance
name: Thymocyte selection, survival and self-tolerance in thymus
rationale: Members cover positive and negative thymic selection, thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis, migration and self-tolerance; confusables concern bone marrow hematopoiesis and B cell progenitors.

name: Anterograde and retrograde intraflagellar transport in cilia
rationale: All members describe bidirectional IFT within cilia for their assembly, distinct from confusables on ciliary cargo targeting, basal body/centriole organization or cilium disassembly.

name: Ascorbate and tetrahydrobiopterin redox cofactors regulating nitric oxide synthase
rationale: Members cover ascorbate and BH4 metabolism, vitamin C/E responses, superoxide removal, oxygen sensing and oxidoreductase/NOS activation; the BH4-NOS regulation distinguishes it from iron, xenobiotic and general ROS-detoxification confusables.

name: Satellite cell self-renewal and restrained myogenic differentiation
rationale: Members cover satellite cell maintenance and division, myoblast proliferation, migration and fusion in regeneration and negative regulation of myoblast/myotube differentiation; confusables emphasize positive myogenesis or muscle atrophy.

name: Immunoglobulin-superfamily cell recognition by DSCAM, sidekick and nectins
rationale: Members are DSCAM and sidekick interactions, nectin/Necl heterodimerization, heterophilic adhesion and dendrite self-avoidance; confusables concern netrin guidance, L1/neurofascin nodal assembly or ephrin repulsion.
